question: Why does the dynamically registered Manager exit with a transition but open without the stock system-app transition?
prototype_hypothesis: native system-app launch routing requires an app_id in the firmware's 8-bit system range; app IDs above 0x00FF are deliberately routed through a reduced external-app transition path
callsite_evidence: the first successful device probe used app_id 0xCA01 and showed no opening animation while the same page had an exit animation
launcher click handler sub_C4F62D8 constructs the same 44-byte navigation request and 56-byte icon-origin animation descriptor for every launcher record
page transition coordinator sub_CA52CF8 calls off_200EB058[13](page.app_id) before selecting the opening transition path
off_200EB058[13] resolves to sub_CA51150, which returns true exactly when app_id > 0x00FF
for IDs above 0x00FF sub_CA52CF8 always uses sub_CA2D950; system-range IDs may use sub_C4A368C with both previous and target pages when the global transition mode is 2
control_flow_evidence: the launcher supplies the clicked icon center through the animation descriptor, so missing origin metadata is not specific to the Canopus launcher record
the high-ID branch is selected before target-page creation and is independent of the Manager on_create implementation
changing the Manager ID from 0xCA01 to unused system-range candidate 0x00CA removes the high-ID branch condition
installation now checks any existing 0x00CA descriptor's package_name and fails with a collision error instead of accepting or replacing an unrelated app
ownership_analysis: The app and page descriptors remain resident and mutable for their registration lifetime. The app ID is both identity and routing metadata; selecting a low ID must therefore be collision-checked before installation.
unsafe_assumptions: 0x00CA had no immediate use in the analyzed image, and the runtime collision guard remains authoritative
the system-range routing behavior is exact-target and must not be generalized to other firmware versions
recommended_probe: Device probe passed: after fresh boot, Manager registered as 0x00CA and showed the stock opening and closing transitions. Preserve the collision guard and <=0x00FF compile-time assertion in production Manager builds.

artifacts.role: launcher click navigation and icon-origin descriptor
